stories.title: Fever's Mitchell sets mark with 20-pt. game streak
stories.summary: Kelsey Mitchell set the WNBA record with her 21st consecutive game with at least 20 points, tying her season high with 37 in the Fever's loss to the Wings.

stories.title: Sources: M's calling up top prospect Anderson
stories.summary: The Mariners are calling up left-hander Kade Anderson, the No. 1 pitching prospect in baseball, to start against the Cubs on Saturday, sources told ESPN.

stories.title: D-backs moving Marte to IL 3 days after no-show
stories.summary: Diamondbacks second baseman Ketel Marte will be transferred to the 10-day injured list, GM Mike Hazen confirmed Thursday, three days after Marte failed to show up for a game in Boston.

stories.title: Jury rules N.Y. Times defamed Bama hoops player
stories.summary: An Alabama jury on Thursday awarded $9.25 million in damages after finding that The New York Times defamed an Alabama basketball player by incorrectly reporting that he was at the scene of a fatal shooting in Tuscaloosa.

stories.title: Too grand: DeGrom 2nd fastest to 2K strikeouts
stories.summary: Rangers pitcher Jacob deGrom became the second-fastest pitcher to reach 2,000 career strikeouts, reaching the milestone in just 1,660⅓ innings.
